gate_and_indicator_networks.detail: every resistor except the rail series element

mcu.detail: the datasheet's own maximum current into VCC, which is far above the part's typical consumption

rail_series_resistor.detail: the element between the coil supply and the logic rail, carrying the whole MCU supply current

relay_coils.detail: 4 coils at the top of the coil rail and the bottom of the coil's resistance tolerance

reverse_polarity_device.detail: the whole board current through the input device

relay_contacts.detail: 4 closed contacts each carrying the marked 4 A at the datasheet's MAXIMUM contact resistance, which is an initial low-current measurement limit; the relay's own 16 A carry rating could not be met if the resistance at rated current were really that high, so this bounds the dissipation from well above

switched_terminals.detail: two contacts per channel carrying the marked 4 A

estimate_class: simple: a dissipation inventory and package-limit derating at a declared ambient. No thermal solve, no copper spreading model, no airflow assumption, and therefore no board temperature and no junction temperature.
not_established: the operating ambient range of the terminal blocks and headers, whose datasheets state none
worst_case: every term is that part's own worst case, so the total bounds any single operating point from above rather than describing one
